en-US.author: https://github.com/pbek
en-US.description: QOwnNotes is the open source notepad with markdown support and todo list manager
en-US.name: QOwnNotes
en-US.releaseNotes:
26.10.13
- Fixed nix run github:pbek/qownnotes failing to build because GitHub flake
  archives omit the required Git submodules
- Added icons to the note list context menu and its folder and tag submenus
  (for #2589,
  thank you, @serebryakov02)
- Raised the CMake compatibility minimum to 3.10 to avoid deprecation warnings
  with recent CMake versions, including for bundled dependencies
- Switched translation source updates to CMake, removing the deprecated qmake input
  to lupdate and preserving existing edits to other languages
  - Include library strings across platforms and optional build features
- Reorganized menus for easier discovery (for #3811)
  - Added top-level Insert and Search menus, moved note deletion, version history,
    and encryption into Note, and flattened Edit → Edit
  - Added a Tools menu for spelling, grammar, dictionaries, AI, stored images and
    attachments, and sending the clipboard, so Edit only contains editing actions
  - Replaced Extra with a Copy submenu and directly accessible editing actions,
    renamed Note text edit to Editor context menu, and moved Activate context menu
    and Allow all note editing into Edit
  - Combined layout selection and management under Window → Layout
  - Adjusted menu access keys so they don't conflict with each other or existing shortcuts
  - Keyboard shortcuts are unchanged
- Added more French, German, Russian, Chinese Simplified, Italian, Portuguese, Brazilian,
  Polish, Spanish, Japanese translation (thank you, jd-develop, pbek, spamcutters)
- There was a new release of QOwnNotes for Android,
  v1.7.0
  - Edit bookmark names, URLs, tags, and descriptions, or delete bookmarks directly from the
    bookmark browser; changes are saved offline to the source Markdown note, preserving unrelated
    text and protecting changed, read-only, or conflicted notes
  - Long-press a checkbox block in the note preview to delete it together with nested items and
    continuation text after confirmation; read-only and conflicted notes remain protected
- There was a new release of QOwnNotes for Android,
  v1.6.1
  - Fixed checkbox dragging and toggling in notes containing checkbox-like lines that are not
    rendered as checkboxes, such as empty items or lines inside HTML comments or code blocks
- The 26.10.4 release of
  QOwnNotes for Nextcloud hides its navigation
  entry for users excluded by Nextcloud's app group restrictions
Released files
- QOwnNotes-x86_64.AppImage: Portable Linux AppImage build with Qt 6
- QOwnNotes-x86_64.AppImage.sha256sum: SHA-256 checksum for the AppImage
- QOwnNotes-amd64.snap: Linux Snap build with Qt 6
- QOwnNotes-amd64.snap.sha256sum: SHA-256 checksum for the Qt 6 Snap package
- QOwnNotes-Qt5-amd64.snap: Linux Snap build with Qt 5 for older environments
- QOwnNotes-Qt5-amd64.snap.sha256sum: SHA-256 checksum for the Qt 5 Snap package
- QOwnNotes.zip: Windows ZIP package built with Qt 6
- QOwnNotes.zip.sha256: SHA-256 checksum for the Qt 6 Windows ZIP package
- QOwnNotes.zip.sha256sum: Alternative SHA-256 checksum file for the Qt 6 Windows ZIP package
- QOwnNotes.dmg: macOS disk image built with Qt 6
- QOwnNotesQt5.dmg: macOS disk image built with Qt 5 for older systems
